controles.affirmation: Nucor Steel Louisiana a recu en 2022 des allegations de violation du Clean Air Act de l'EPA ; un reglement combine est toujours en negociation avec le DOJ, l'EPA et le regulateur environnemental de Louisiane ; Nucor n'anticipe pas d'impact materiel
controles.verbatim_source: During 2022, Nucor Steel Louisiana, our DRI facility located in St. James Parish, Louisiana, received allegations of violations of the Clean Air Act from the United States Environmental Protection Agency. A combined settlement is currently being negotiated with the United States Department of Justice, the United States Environmental Protection Agency and the Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality. We do not believe that any aggregate settlement for these allegations will be material to Nucor. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Conforme mot a mot, y compris la prudence du terme "allegations" (et non enquete ou poursuite). Aucune correction.

controles.affirmation: Nucor attribue EXPLICITEMENT une partie de ses profits a la protection tarifaire plutot qu'a sa seule competitivite
controles.verbatim_source: "Earnings in the steel mills segment increased in the second quarter of 2026 due to higher average selling prices, increased volumes and higher metal margins. [...] Federal trade policies, including anti-dumping and countervailing duty laws in combination with Section 232 national security tariffs, are continuing to reduce the volume of unfairly traded imports into the United States." (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: La seconde phrase est reproduite fidelement, mais le 10-Q n'attribue nulle part ses profits aux tarifs : il attribue explicitement la hausse des resultats aux prix de vente, aux volumes et aux marges metal, et mentionne l'effet des politiques commerciales sur les VOLUMES D'IMPORTATIONS, pas sur ses resultats. Retirer "explicitement" du titre et du hook, et reformuler : "Nucor souligne que les droits antidumping et la Section 232 continuent de reduire les importations jugees deloyales, un environnement de prix protege dont depend une partie de son pouvoir de fixation des prix."

controles.affirmation: Les couts de pre-exploitation et de demarrage DE CES SITES (acierie de Virginie-Occidentale, extension Nucor Towers & Structures, ligne de galvanisation en Caroline du Sud) ont represente 120 M$ au seul T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "Pre-operating and start-up costs of new facilities were approximately $120 million in the second quarter of 2026 and approximately $136 million in the second quarter of 2025. Pre-operating and start-up costs in the second quarter of 2026 primarily included costs related to the sheet mill in West Virginia and the coating complex at our sheet mill in Indiana." (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Deux problemes. 1) Mauvaise affectation : les 120 M$ portent principalement sur la Virginie-Occidentale et le complexe de revetement de l'INDIANA, pas sur NTS ni sur la Caroline du Sud (qui sont les trois plus gros postes de CAPEX 2026, une liste differente). 2) Omission de sens inverse : ces couts sont en BAISSE, de 136 M$ au T2 2025 a 120 M$ au T2 2026. Reecrire en separant la liste CAPEX de la liste des couts de demarrage, et mentionner la baisse annuelle.

controles.affirmation: 191 M$ de la hausse du benefice net (603 -> 1 156 M$) viennent d'un remboursement ponctuel de 130 M$ et d'un gain comptable de 61 M$
controles.verbatim_source: "a reduction to cost of products sold of $130 million related to cash refunds associated with prior periods' raw materials procurement costs" ; "a non-cash benefit of $61 million ... The increase is included as a reduction of marketing, administrative and other expenses" (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux montants sont exacts mais ce sont des elements AVANT IMPOT, retranches d'une variation de benefice NET (553 M$) qui est apres impot. A un taux effectif proche de 24%, la contribution nette des deux elements est d'environ 145 M$, pas 191 M$. Ecrire "191 M$ avant impot, soit environ 145 M$ apres impot sur une hausse de 553 M$".

controles.affirmation: Marge brute de 2,03 Mds $ (20%) au T2 2026 contre 1,22 Mds $ (14%) ; cout moyen ferraille 422 $ contre 403 $ (+5%)
controles.verbatim_source: "Nucor recorded gross margins of $2.03 billion (20%) in the second quarter of 2026, which was an increase compared to $1.22 billion (14%) in the second quarter of 2025." ; "The average scrap and scrap substitute cost per gross ton used in the second quarter of 2026 was $422, a 5% increase compared to $403" (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Current ratio 2,5 contre 2,9 fin 2025, du fait du reclassement de 500 M$ d'obligations 4,300% echeance 2027 ; dette totale 7 099 M$, tresorerie 2,69 Mds $, notations A-/A-/A3
controles.verbatim_source: "The current ratio was 2.5 at the end of the second quarter of 2026 and 2.9 at year-end 2025 ... the reclassification of the Company's $500 million principal amount of its 4.300% Notes due 2027" ; "total cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments of $2.69 billion" ; "the highest credit ratings of any steel producer headquartered in North America, with an A- long-term rating from Standard & Poor's, an A- long-term rating from Fitch Ratings and an A3 long-term rating from Moody's" ; bilan : 129 + 581 + 6,389 = 7 099 M$ (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: CAPEX estimes a 2,50 Mds $ pour 2026 ; taux d'utilisation 65% produits en acier, 88% acieries, 76% matieres premieres au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "Capital expenditures for 2026 are estimated to be approximately $2.50 billion as compared to $3.42 billion in 2025." ; "The average utilization rates of all operating facilities in the steel mills, steel products and raw materials segments were approximately 88%, 65% and 76%, respectively, in the first six months of 2026" (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Le segment produits en acier voit son benefice reculer malgre volumes et prix en hausse, du fait des couts des intrants acier
controles.verbatim_source: "The steel products segment had decreased earnings in the second quarter of 2026 as compared to the second quarter of 2025 as increased volumes and modestly higher average selling prices were more than offset by margin compression resulting from higher steel input costs." (10-Q T2 2026)
